findings.contract_clause: SERVICE.md: Inputs — the driven-equipment suitability manifest
findings.detail: The service returned a 200 OK with an INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict instead of a 422 Unprocessable Entity for malformed input (type mismatch on equipment_kind and duty).

notes: The atom correctly handles logic and determinism for valid inputs. However, the malformed input case fails to trigger the required 422 HTTP status, indicating a lack of input validation at the gateway/entry level.
